track.name: Ashiyan
track.caption: press play – this one always reminds me of you and our long drives.

notes.quote: you've covered for me, fought for me, and shown up for me more times than i can count. i noticed every single one.
no one roasts me like you. no one cheers me up like you either. i'd pick our brand of nonsense any day.
through every high and low, you've been my constant anchor. thank you for simply being you—my absolute favorite human.

memories.caption: the way you laugh at your own jokes — i hope you never stop.
every dumb adventure with you turned out to be the best memory.
thank you for being my first friend, and the loudest one.

paragraphs: I'm not great at this — saying soft stuff to your face — so I made you a tiny page instead. a song, our pictures, and a few things I actually mean.
thank you for being the loudest, most chaotic, most reliable person in my corner. for the late-night plans, the random calls, and every time you pretended not to notice I was a mess.

I hope today feels like yours. I hope someone gets the order right, the wifi doesn't drop, and you laugh at least once for no reason. and I hope you know — even when I don't say it — I'm so glad you're my best friend.
